summary: Backend + frontend regression for iteration 7 (share OG cards + Midtrans premium partners). 18/18 backend tests pass. Frontend critical flows validated: share link uses /api/share/{slug}, preview image 1200x630 renders, cookie-less visit lands on /trip/{slug} (public-trip-page). Admin plans tab lists plan-row-1m/3m/12m. /partners shows premium-partners-section; upgrade dialog opens, calls /api/payments/snap-token and invokes snap.pay with real sandbox token. Mobile bottom-nav OK at 390x844. Only one minor backend bug found in /api/payments/{order_id}/status.

minor.issue: apply_payment() is called with the Midtrans /v2/{order_id}/status JSON, which for sandbox errors/unknown orders can be a dict without 'order_id'. apply_payment then queries db.payment_orders with order_id=None, raises HTTPException(404), and that 404 bubbles up as the endpoint response even though the local order exists. Guard: only call apply_payment if m.get('order_id') matches, or catch and ignore the mismatch.

action_items: Optional: harden /api/payments/{order_id}/status to not 404 when Midtrans returns a body missing order_id (see minor issue above). Not blocking; webhook flow already covers premium activation and is idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1530 lines; consider splitting into modules (payments, share, partners, itineraries) for maintainability.
payment_status endpoint should not silently trust arbitrary Midtrans response shapes — verify m.get('order_id') == order_id before calling apply_payment.
add_months uses base.replace(day=...) with a leap-year check that only handles the current-year leap rule; edge cases OK for months<=12 but consider using dateutil.relativedelta for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Test itineraries and partners (TEST_ prefixed) are created and cleaned up by fixtures in test_iteration7.py. During run, one approved 'TEST_ Kopi Toba' partner was activated to premium via a signed settlement webhook; teardown deletes the partner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration7.py covers: OG HTML+image (PIL 1200x630 verify), premium plans CRUD auth/validation, payments/config, snap-token (success + 3 error paths), webhook signature/missing/pending/settlement/idempotent, /partners sorting with premium first. Run with: `export $(grep -v ^# /app/frontend/.env | xargs); export ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@wisatasumut.id ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123; pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py -n 0 -v`. Note: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; this suite writes cross-test shared state (pytest.snap_order_id) so use `-n 0` to run serially, or accept loadscope which keeps a class on the same worker.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. The one minor issue on /payments/{id}/status is caused by trusting the outer Midtrans status-check response as a valid notification payload.
